newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Feb unemployment to reach 4.7 mln - Bild.
newsitem.headline: German Feb unemployment to reach 4.7 mln - Bild.

text.p: German unemployment will show a rise to 4.7 million in February from 4.66 million a month earlier, a smaller increase than previously reported, the Bild newspaper said on Tuesday.
Official jobless statistics for February are due to be released on Thursday.

January's rise to 4.66 million sparked speculation that Germany's economic recovery remained too sluggish for the country to qualify for European monetary union without taking substantial new measures to boost taxes or slash spending.
On Sunday, Bild's affiliate, the Bild am Sonntag, said February unemployment would reach 4.8 million.
